title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
description: Central legislation governing the processing of digital personal data and related rights and obligations.

description: Final rules made under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

description: Official MeitY material describing the phased enforcement timeline for the DPDP framework.

description: Official MeitY material concerning the establishment of the Data Protection Board of India under the DPDP framework.

description: Official final Rules material relevant to consent mechanisms and processing of children's personal data.

description: Official final Rules material relevant to personal data breach intimation and related compliance requirements.
